name: ovos-stt-plugin-sherpa-onnx
description: An OpenVoiceOS Speech-to-Text plugin that uses Sherpa-ONNX, the Kaldi-based speech recognition toolkit from k2-fsa. The plugin runs fully offline and supports Transducer, Whisper, Moonshine, Paraformer, and several CTC model architectures.
author: TigreGotico
